description: This file defines an interface 'PolicyCommandResponse' related to responses for policy commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures, default method implementations, and a nested class 'JsonFields' that provides JSON field definitions for serialization.

classes.name: PolicyCommandResponse
classes.description: An interface representing a response related to a policy command, providing methods for schema version support, resource identification, and header management.

classes.name: PolicyCommandResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: A static nested class that defines JSON field metadata for PolicyCommandResponse, specifically the 'policyId' JSON field.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the supported JSON schema versions for PolicyCommandResponse, specifically version V_2.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type associated with PolicyCommandResponse.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the PolicyId associated with the response.
